text: Let us pray. Eternal Lord God, who by the Holy Spirit presided at accounts of being apostles to guide them in all knowledge and truth be present with those whose take counsel on this place in the passions of debate, give them a quiet spirit and complexities that issues give them clear minds and in the moments of decision, to encourage his hearts. Guide 11 is new business and we need to understand anyone.
